blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte is not a signatory to the purchase of P41 million worth of manager’s checks using a joint account she shares with her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, as shown in documents issued by the Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI). Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis Escudero made the confirmation during the defense’s cross-examination of BPI Central Metro Manila Branches Division Head Marwin Galvez. “Vice President Sara Duterte’s signature does not appear in any of the transaction documents, such as the opening and closing of the time deposit and the purchase of manager’s checks,” […]...
